_readme: Workshop settings. Edit freely; the app reloads this file on every page load. See README.md for details of each field.
title: malariasimulation constitution workshop
subtitle: What belongs in the core model?
intro: You'll be shown a few hypothetical proposed changes to malariasimulation. For each one, decide where it belongs and tell us why. Work on your own: there are no right answers, and disagreement is the useful part.

storage._readme: Leave supabaseUrl empty to run in local demo mode (data stays in this browser). For the real workshop, paste your Supabase project URL and its publishable (or legacy anon) key.

decisions.label: NO
decisions.description: Should not be maintained in this ecosystem

categories.label: Purpose
categories.heading: Purpose
categories.prompt: What is malariasimulation for, and who is it for?
categories.suggestedPrinciple: malariasimulation exists to answer policy questions about malaria transmission and control that recur across many settings, not to serve any single project.

categories.label: Scope
categories.heading: Scope
categories.prompt: What belongs in the core model, and what belongs elsewhere in the malariaverse?

categories.label: Scientific evidence
categories.heading: Scientific standards
categories.prompt: What evidence should a new mechanism or intervention need?

categories.label: Validation
categories.heading: Validation
categories.prompt: How must changes be tested and validated before they are merged?

categories.label: Technical standards
categories.heading: Technical standards
categories.prompt: Code quality, testing, dependencies, interfaces and backwards compatibility.

categories.label: Performance
categories.heading: Performance and complexity
categories.prompt: How much runtime or complexity is a feature allowed to cost?

categories.label: Usability
categories.heading: Usability
categories.prompt: Documentation, defaults and the experience of new users.

categories.label: Maintenance
categories.heading: Maintenance and ownership
categories.prompt: Who looks after a feature once it is merged, and for how long?

categories.label: Governance
categories.heading: Governance and decision-making
categories.prompt: Who decides, how, and how are decisions recorded and revisited?

votes.label: Amend
votes.hint: Right idea, but the wording needs work

schedule._readme: Suggested minutes for each facilitator step; each step page shows a timer you can start. Use 0 to hide a timer.

ratification._readme: Share of votes that must be 'agree' before a principle is highlighted as ready to ratify. The facilitator still decides.

disagreement._readme: Disagreement is the chance that two randomly chosen reviewers of a case picked different options (0 = unanimous, 1 = everyone different). Cases need at least minResponses answers before they are labelled.

export.title: malariasimulation constitution
export.preamble: This document sets out the principles the malariasimulation team uses to decide what belongs in the core model and what belongs elsewhere in the malariaverse. It is a living draft, first agreed at a team workshop.
